name: Pause AI
author: nzkritik
description: Freeze every AI agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode...) from the bar, indefinitely or for a set time, and resume them exactly where they were.

barWidget.description: Left click pauses or resumes all AI agents; right click pauses them for a set time

schema.label: Extra agent commands
schema.description: Space-separated command names to treat as agents too, on top of claude, codex, gemini, opencode, cursor-agent, crush, aider, goose, amp, qwen and copilot.
